select rownum, c.name ,CM_RPORT.get_krediticelbeden(p.expertid) as celbeden ,p.dateofconclusion,p.duedatefirstcontract,CM_RPORT.get_bolgu(p.id) as sahebolusu,
m.odenishtar oddat,v.val_name,m.ayliqodenish "ayliq odenish",m.verilmishkr verilmish,
m.odenilmishkr odenilmish,h.rest,p.annualyinterestrate ||'%' stafka,CM_COMMON.accountnumber_get(ac.booroweraccid)as carihes,
CM_COMMON.get_accountrest(ac.booroweraccid,:dat) as carihq,m.ebkohneborc duerest,
m.cariaydaodenilmelib cariayd_od  ,m.cemiodeneneb cemi_od
,m.gecguneb gecgun ,m.faizborckohne gecfaiz,m.cariayhesfaiz carihes_faiz
, m.cemifaiz Full_Faiz ,m.faizgecgun Get_GEC_faizGun from 
CM_SB_CUSTOMERS c,
cm_active_credits p,
avalute v,
cm_history h,
cm_accounts ac,
cm_monthspayment m
where
p.boorowerid=c.id and
p.currency=v.valute and 
h.creditid=p.id and 
h.hdate=:dat and 
p.id=ac.creditid and
p.id=m.creditid
